src/auth/connect.ts.boundary: Obsidian store reads, schema/path validation and asynchronous connection effects; no independent pure return calculation remains.

src/auth/credentials.ts.boundary: URL parsing, credential callback and JSON/schema serialization. Origin/path authorization delegates to the verified credentialScope predicate.

src/auth/setup-code.ts.boundary: WebCrypto, random typed arrays, base64, regex and timed encryption/decryption. IEEE-754 expiration arithmetic and cryptographic algorithms are not modeled by this prover.

src/auth/setup-transfer.ts.boundary: Schema/URL validation, thrown errors, current UI store reads and async connection; JSON payload decoding is outside the verified subset.

src/core/blobs.ts.boundary: Mutable BinaryObjects instances, SHA-1, byte encoding and schema validation. Class heap mutation and cryptographic correctness are not modeled.

src/core/checkpoint.ts.boundary: Effect Schema declaration; no implementation function body.

src/core/config.ts.boundary: Effect Schema decoding and time-dependent defaults (Date.now). Validation and clock semantics are external.

src/core/content.ts.boundary: Typed-array/base64/UTF-8 codecs, SHA-256 and regex extension parsing. Content equality delegates to verified equalContent; text construction is re-exported from a verified module.

src/core/engine.ts.boundary: Effect orchestration with mutable CRDT maps, durable writes and external state. Rename selection delegates to renamedPath; persistence/concurrency remain integration-tested.

src/core/errors.ts.boundary: Effect exception adapters and runtime instanceof/cause traversal on JavaScript Error instances, including possible cyclic object graphs.

src/core/file.ts.boundary: Yjs document heap mutation, diff library, schema decoding and UUIDs. Comparator delegates to descendingId; no assumed Yjs model is used.

src/core/hash.ts.boundary: Noble SHA-256 and UTF-8 encoding; external cryptographic implementation.

src/core/history.ts.boundary: Yjs snapshots, object identity, random IDs, timestamps, Map aggregation, JSON byte-budget trimming and sort. Empty state and change classification delegate to verified functions. Sort is axiomatic in the pinned translator.

src/core/metadata.ts.boundary: Schema validation and SyncError throwing around verified migrationSequence and metadataValue. Migration registry is configuration data, not an independently executed function.

src/core/ports.ts.boundary: Interfaces/types only; no runtime function body.

src/core/projection.ts.boundary: Mutable FileDocument projection, regex conflict suffix insertion, sorting and write scheduling over maps. Owner overlap and write disposition delegate to verified predicates; object lifecycle is outside the model.

src/core/protocol.ts.boundary: Effect Schema decoding, RegExp path validation and throwing validation adapters. Full RegExp and Unicode case-folding semantics are not modeled.

src/core/reconcile.ts.boundary: Yjs mutations, hash computation and identity/Map-based replay. Conflict, checkpoint and rebased-edit predicates delegate to verified functions.

src/core/services.ts.boundary: Effect Context/Layer composition; external service runtime.

src/core/storage-format.ts.boundary: JSON parsing, schema decoding and Effect/SyncError failure behavior; parser semantics are external.

src/core/storage-layout.ts.boundary: Yjs decoding and destruction; resulting layout selection delegates to verified stateLocation.

src/git/consolidation.ts.boundary: Git I/O, Effect control flow, commit construction and force-push recovery. Publication-state and consolidation-hash decisions delegate to verified functions; no proof of server concurrency.

src/git/objects.ts.boundary: Git tree/blob I/O, RegExp entry parsing, binary codecs, hash validation and mutable maps. Storage-path checks delegate to verified predicates.

src/git/push-lease.ts.boundary: Asynchronous Response decoding and RegExp Git advertisement parsing; remote protocol/transport is external.

src/git/remote.ts.boundary: URL parsing, whitespace RegExp, Git/Effect operations. URL policy delegates to verified allowedRemote after parsing.

src/git/session.ts.boundary: just-git command execution, Request/Response I/O, cache/ref mutation and network error handling; transport semantics are external.

src/git/status.ts.boundary: Git tree I/O and JSON serialization; status projection includes library and mutable repository state.

src/git/vaults.ts.boundary: RegExp storage-layout parser, Set aggregation, sorting and throwing validation; regex and sorting implementation are not proved.

src/main.ts.boundary: Obsidian plugin lifecycle, mutable instance state and Effect/Promise execution. Readiness and outcome decisions are delegated to verified sync-decisions; callbacks remain framework adapters.

src/maintenance/binary-references.ts.boundary: Yjs updates, schema/JSON decoding, binary codecs and mutable blob stores; migration adapters require external library semantics.

src/maintenance/compact.ts.boundary: Yjs recreation, byte/hash conversion and mutable file maps; compaction integrity remains covered by integration tests.

src/maintenance/engine.ts.boundary: Effect migration execution, plugin-supplied callbacks, object-identity registry check, RegExp IDs, typed-array cloning and random hash generation. Sequence ordering is verified separately.

src/maintenance/legacy-validation.ts.boundary: Legacy RegExp/schema/JSON/Yjs parsing and binary hash validation. Snapshot and hidden-path checks delegate to verified predicates.

src/maintenance/metadata.ts.boundary: JSON/schema/UTF-8 decoding, legacy Uint8Array conversion, thrown errors and serialization; no trusted decoder axioms.

src/maintenance/reinitialize.ts.boundary: RegExp vault discovery, Yjs documents, byte codecs and random IDs. Metadata exclusion and hidden-path rules delegate to verified predicates.

src/maintenance/unified-metadata.ts.boundary: Effect migration adapter calling JSON/schema readers and validators; unsupported dynamic unknown objects and external decoding.

src/maintenance/validation.ts.boundary: RegExp/schema/JSON/Yjs parsing and binary hash validation. Snapshot and hidden-path checks delegate to verified predicates.

src/maintenance/vault-storage.ts.boundary: RegExp relocation, JSON/schema recovery, bytes and mutable file maps; no model of parsing failures.

src/platform/consolidation.ts.boundary: Obsidian filesystem I/O, JSON/schema and durable checkpoint replacement. Journal-install safety delegates to verified installableJournal.

src/platform/device.ts.boundary: OS/platform access, secret storage, UUIDs, Unicode trim and RegExp author sanitization; external environment and regex semantics.

src/platform/git-cache.ts.boundary: Obsidian filesystem adapter, mutable LRU cache, typed arrays, RegExp object paths and Date objects; cache heap and I/O behavior are not modeled.

src/platform/http.ts.boundary: Request/Response conversion, Obsidian network requests and Promise/timer race; genuine asynchronous operations.

src/platform/retry.ts.boundary: Effect fibers, mutable scheduler state and clocks. retryDelay uses exponentiation and IEEE-754 jitter arithmetic; proving an integer/real approximation would not prove the JavaScript function.

src/platform/storage.ts.boundary: Throwing adapter around verified safeStoragePath plus asynchronous directory creation; external filesystem semantics.

src/platform/vault.ts.boundary: Obsidian mutable files and I/O, atomic-process callbacks, schema and binary codecs. Content and hidden-path decisions delegate to verified functions.

src/ui/actions.ts.boundary: Callbacks adapt Obsidian plugin methods to UI Promise interfaces; external plugin state and effects.

src/ui/components.tsx.boundary: React/Radix JSX, DOM events and Unicode field naming; rendering and event delivery are external.

src/ui/consolidation-modal.tsx.boundary: Obsidian Modal lifecycle, React rendering, mutable instance state and asynchronous maintenance callbacks.

src/ui/consolidation-panel.tsx.boundary: React hooks, JSX and asynchronous submit callbacks. Checklist acceptance delegates to a verified function; approved copy remains render data.

src/ui/controls.tsx.boundary: Re-exported Radix primitives; no local implementation.

src/ui/diff-highlighter.ts.boundary: Shiki runtime, regex engine and dynamic grammar import; external renderer.

src/ui/file-history-modal.tsx.boundary: Obsidian Modal/React lifecycle and mutable render roots; framework adapter.

src/ui/file-history.tsx.boundary: React JSX/hooks, DOM measurement/scrolling and external diff parsing/counts. History summary, preview values and matching delegate to verified functions; no model of diff library or DOM layout.

src/ui/history-panel.tsx.boundary: React external-store hook and JSX rendering; external event/render semantics.

src/ui/history-view.tsx.boundary: Obsidian ItemView lifecycle and React rendering; constant framework metadata methods have no algorithm to extract.

src/ui/icon-button.tsx.boundary: React JSX/hook/ref and Obsidian tooltip adapter; DOM effects.

src/ui/settings.ts.boundary: Obsidian settings metadata and React root lifecycle callbacks; framework-controlled mutable DOM.

src/ui/setup-form.tsx.boundary: React hooks, JSX and event dispatch into setup/maintenance actions; external UI runtime.

src/ui/setup-transfer-modal.ts.boundary: Obsidian modal DOM, QR canvas rendering, timers and encryption/connection Promises; external UI/crypto APIs.

src/ui/store.ts.boundary: Mutable closure snapshot, Partial object patches and listener callbacks; JavaScript identity and notification side effects are outside the pure model.

src/ui/sync-history.tsx.boundary: React JSX/hooks, RegExp search, Intl.Collator sorting and Date-based day grouping. File naming delegates to verified fileName; locale/timezone behavior remains external.

src/ui/sync-issue.ts.boundary: JavaScript Error/SyncError instanceof and bounded cause traversal; user-facing copy is produced by verified issueValue.

src/ui/sync-preferences.tsx.boundary: React JSX/hooks, DOM number parsing and asynchronous persistence callbacks; external UI runtime.

src/ui/sync-status.tsx.boundary: React JSX/hooks, Intl.DateTimeFormat and snapshot field adapters. Status policy, descriptions, colors and blocking delegate to verified functions.

src/ui/use-setup.ts.boundary: React external-store state, schema/URL checks and asynchronous connection callbacks. Saved-credential matching delegates to a verified function.
